s.note: Fred's hustle on the Chicago streets
s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts until blistered and tuck into 8 soft buns. Top each with mustard, relish, diced onion, tomato wedges and a dill pickle spear, and serve on a big platter.

s.note: the elves' workshop in the busy week
s.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar, then mix in 300g self-raising flour and 2 tsp ginger. Roll, cut out men and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Pipe on icing once cool.

m.note: the Claus family together at Christmas
m.how: Score the skin of a 2kg half ham in diamonds. Brush with 100g honey mixed with 2 tbsp Dijon and 50g brown sugar and bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes.

w.note: the cookies that keep Nick so round
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips. Roll 16 balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve with cold milk.

d.note: a freezing night at the North Pole
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs and float a handful of marshmallows on top of each.
